text: Okay, so why are obstacles so important for our signal? Because of the diffraction. And again, at least in Italy, we studied that in high school. Diffraction is a phenomenon that consists in the following: we have one signal that is transmitted. When the signal hits the obstacle, several secondary waves are created. So the signal does not remain only one, but it.
